items.text: Hey Teleposters, a free update just launched for KeyWe! Strap in.
New Challenges
We’ve added Challenges to more levels! Laser security systems, parachuting airmail, supercharged vacuum tubes - how much chaos can two kiwis handle? You decide.

Like the first round of Challenges, these add new objectives for Jeff & Debra to tackle. Each level’s Challenge is different; some emphasize memory, or jumping skills, or careful aim. Some are just about going FAST.
Complete Challenges to earn Challenge Coins, and unlock special cosmetics in the Wardrobe. Speaking of which…
New Wardrobe Stuff
We’ve added a crateful of new kiwi customizations, including:
• New skins! Prowl the post office with Tiger Stripes, or sparkle with Starlight.
• New shoes! Cowboy boots and high heels, in a range of colors to fit your feathered fancy.
• New backpacks! Put on a pair of elegant Butterfly Wings, or rev up the mechanical Propeller Pack.
• ROBOT ARMS.
Other Stuff

Challenges are now off by default. When picking a level in the main menu, you’ll see a new Challenge button, next to the Start button. Push it to see a level’s Challenge objective, and to start the level in Challenge mode. (To play the normal version of a level, just push the Start button instead.) Once in the level, you can check the Pause menu for a reminder of the Challenge objective.
Rebalanced some existing Challenges
Various UI updates to better accommodate the Challenge system
Added some new SFX here and there
Various bug fixes
Thanks for playing KeyWe. Your support and feedback continues to keep the cassowaries fed and our hearts warm. Happy Teleposting!
We have made a couple of enhancements to KeyWe.
More messaging has been added around online connection issues.

Fixed issue where players in the central US region weren't able to connect to one another (this also: affected players in Mexico City): Appreciate your continued support fellow Teleposters! - KeyWe Team
A small update fixing a blocker to Level 2 of Summer.
Happy Posting! Enjoy!
Hey Teleposters, we’re excited to announce a new KeyWe update, just in time for Hollyjostle!
This is a free patch for all PC players, and it’s available now. The update includes:
Challenges!
Some levels now offer optional Challenge objectives - just look for the Challenge Coin icon in the Calendar or Overtime Shift board.

Can you win the Snowball Fight without letting a single cassowary throw a snowball? How about popping every red bubble in the Bubble Wrap Testing room? Some of these are meant to be pretty tough, even for seasoned Teleposters, and we can’t wait to see your kiwi tactics in action. We believe in you (and Jeff and Debra)!
Aside from an immense feeling of accomplishment, beating Challenges will also bag you some…
New kiwi customizations!

Completing Challenges will earn you Challenge Coins, which you can spend on newly-added stuff in the Wardrobe. Bungalow Basin’s winter Hollyjostle celebration is in full swing, so we’ve added a flurry of festive items like Reindeer Antlers, fuzzy Winter Boots, and the incredible Walrus Tusks facewear. We think that last one is really gonna knock your socks off.

This patch will also add some Wardrobe items that you can get with regular ol’ Stamps, like the Elfen Winklepicker shoes (they jingle when you run!) and the Peppermint Plumage skin (which looks extremely fresh).
We don’t want to spoil everything here, though. The best thing you can do is download and play it yourselves! Let us know what you think in the comments or over on Twitter.

Thanks for playing KeyWe. Your postal antics and support are a constant source of joy and inspiration for our team. From everybirdy here at Stonewheat & Sons and Fireshine Games, have a very Happy Hollyjostle!

Hey there Teleposters, we hope you’re having a great time tackling the Telepost so far. We wanted to say a BIG thank you for all of your support over on the official KeyWe Twitter and Discord channels – we love seeing your wardrobe choices and hearing about your favourite characters and levels.

Whilst kiwis are omnivores and their diet primarily consists of insects, they can’t be expected to run the Telepost and take care of any bugs they spot along the way. Don’t worry, though, that’s where your handy KeyWe development team comes in! Read on for the latest KeyWe patch notes…
You reported some synchronisation issues with the Telegraph Desk levels. We’ve submitted some safety nets to try and catch these issues!

We’ve implemented a fix so that the post toaster is a little more forgiving in terms of timing – there’s no such thing as perfect timing, after all! We also fixed an issue with the buckles on the Cassowary bags in the winter levels – we guess the cold weather was making them difficult to fasten!

After completing a goal with the "overcharged" mechanic (where your kiwis glow blue and red), the game would not let you progress. We’re pleased to report that this bug has well and truly been zapped!

Some of our winter weather mechanics (namely the ice blocks and conveyor belts) weren’t functioning properly in online games. We’ve since fixed this frosty little bug AND we’ve increased the lantern radius to make melting the ice a little bit easier, but we are aware of some other issues with this level that we'll be looking to patch at a later date. If you encounter any problems in the meantime, the best course of action is to return to the main menu and relaunch the level from the calendar.
We’ve patched in a fix for a known issue where your kiwis can get stuck falling forever (spooky!), but please let us know if you’re still encountering this issue.
This level wasn’t displaying messages properly when the timer was turned off. This has been repaired, and you can now take this level at your own pace again.
Those pesky mailflies were blocking the crane controls and giving the kiwis a real hard time! We’ve given them a stern talking to, so this shouldn’t be an issue anymore.
We know this skin was displaying some rather funky colours. While cool to look at, this has been restored to its former glory.
We’ve fixed this collectible puzzle.
A new feature has been added that allows players to assign controllers and choose their keyboard layout!
Players can now choose who uses what controller.
Players can choose if player 2 uses the numpad or other keys on the keyboard (if you don’t have a numpad).
If you’re using a single controller, the other player can now use the full keyboard layout.
We put in a fix for an issue where players in Turkey couldn’t play online and have tested this as best as we can without flying to Turkey and testing there!
There was also an issue where players who had Windows set to Turkish weren’t able to see certain text characters in the game. This has been repaired!
Russian text no longer clips through the ramps in Dropoff Depot levels.
Fixed broken Spanish messages in Transcription Room levels.
Fixed broken Italian messages in Transcription Room levels.
Fixed issues where certain words wouldn’t appear in the winter Telegraph Desk levels when playing in non-English languages.
Improved collision across multiple levels.
Fixed issue with swapping kiwi customizations when playing online.
Fixed issue in the Wardrobe with kiwi customizations being swapped after new item reveal.
Fixed issue where personal best times show up in match results after failing a level.
Put in catch-all to unlock progress wearables and award achievements that were earned on Demo accounts.
Fixed Summer Postmaster and Fall Postmaster achievements.
We hope these fixes make your KeyWe experience even more enjoyable! If you encounter anything in KeyWe that you think we need to be aware of, please feel free to email customerservice@soldout.uk.com.
